# PlayerActionState

[API index](../index.md)

What keeps the player from starting an ordinary skill now: of the causes that hold, the one that lets
the fewest skills through. Skill readiness (`CanBeUsed`, `CanBeUsedInUi`) does not include it; check
both before pressing.

**@keywords**

busy, casting, stunned, interrupted, skill press

## Unknown

```typescript
Unknown = "Unknown",
```

No fresh player data this tick, for example while loading; neither busy nor free.

## Free

```typescript
Free = "Free",
```

None of these causes blocks an ordinary skill; moving does not.

## ActionsInterrupted

```typescript
ActionsInterrupted = "ActionsInterrupted",
```

Stunned, electrocuted or reacting to a hit or block: no skill starts, not even dodge.

## NonInstantSkillsDisabled

```typescript
NonInstantSkillsDisabled = "NonInstantSkillsDisabled",
```

Stat `your_non_instant_skills_are_disabled` is set: ordinary skills and dodge do not start; movement
and interaction still do.

## UsingAbility

```typescript
UsingAbility = "UsingAbility",
```

An action is in progress; dodge and defensive skills may still cancel it.
